title: My Day in Characters
label: ch:zh-my-day-in-characters
canDo: I can read a short day in characters and write one line of my own.

payoff.summary: Complete ZH-W97-my-own-line: one line of your own Chinese about where you are, what you want and for how long, chosen rather than copied, with every word you have not written in pinyin.
payoff.note: The first Chinese the reader writes with nothing to copy (controlled composition). Pinyin inside the line is licensed for words whose characters the book has not taught, as assessment-spec.md requires a task to say; a character the reader only recognises is not one they produce.
